<!-- Generated by internal/tools/docgen (task docs-gen). Edit the code, not this file. -->

An entity's identity in a sketch is its type and its **primary** field:
adding the same value again updates the entity instead of making a
second one. A type marked *detected* is recognized in pasted text.
Fields not listed here are kept too, as custom fields. An administrator
can add types of their own, see [custom types](/extending/custom-types/).

## Global

### Event

`event`

Something that happened or is planned, with when, where and who.

| Field | Kind | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | **primary**, required, What happened or will happen |
| `starts_at` | datetime | When it starts |
| `ends_at` | datetime | When it ends |
| `location` | location | Where it takes place |
| `description` | string | What is known about it |
| `participants` | list of string | Who takes part |
| `source` | url | Where the event was reported |

`location`

Represents a physical address with geographical coordinates.

| `longitude` | float | Longitude coordinate of the address |

### Phrase

`phrase`

Represents a phrase or text content.

| Field | Kind | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | any | **primary**, required, The content of the phrase |

## Security & Access

### CVE

`cve`, detected

A public CVE record, which findings and vulnerabilities may name.

| Field | Kind | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | **primary**, required, Such as CVE-2021-44228 |
| `url` | url | The record's page |
| `severity` | string | As the record rates it, one of info, low, medium, high, critical |
| `cvss` | float | Base score, 0 to 10, from 0 to 10 |
| `cvss_vector` | string | Such as CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H |
| `cwe` | string | The weakness class, such as CWE-502 |
| `description` | string | The record's summary |
| `published` | datetime | When the record was published |
| `known_exploited` | bool | Listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities |
| `kev_added` | datetime | When CISA listed it as exploited |
| `epss` | float | Probability of exploitation in the next 30 days, 0 to 1 (FIRST), from 0 to 1 |
| `epss_percentile` | float | Share of all CVEs scored lower, 0 to 1, from 0 to 1 |
| `references` | list of string | Advisories and links |

### Credential

`credential`, detected

A login at a service with the password or hash found for it, or a found key, token, JWT or SSH key known by its fingerprint.

| Field | Kind | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | string | **primary**, Login name, empty for a bare key |
| `service` | string | What the credential opens, a site, a host, a provider |
| `kind` | string | What kind of credential it is, one of password, api_key, token, jwt, ssh_key, private_key, other |
| `value` | string | secret, masked until shown, The key, token or private key as it was found |
| `fingerprint` | string | The first twelve hex characters of the key's SHA-256, its identity |
| `prefix` | string | The first four characters of the key, or the SSH algorithm, to tell it apart |
| `status` | string | Whether it still works, one of active, revoked, compromised, unknown |
| `url` | url | Where it signs in |
| `found_in` | string | Where it was found, a leak, a repository, a paste |
| `first_seen` | datetime | When it was first seen |
| `last_seen` | datetime | When it was last seen |
| `password` | string | secret, masked until shown, The password as it was found, in a leak or a paste |
| `password_hash` | string | secret, masked until shown, The hash as it leaked |
| `hash_type` | string | Algorithm of the leaked hash |
| `description` | string | Notes about the credential |
